// File-only public ProtoJSON oracle. No Pulse code or telemetry exporters.
package main

import (
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	logs "go.opentelemetry.io/proto/otlp/collector/logs/v1"
	metrics "go.opentelemetry.io/proto/otlp/collector/metrics/v1"
	traces "go.opentelemetry.io/proto/otlp/collector/trace/v1"
	common "go.opentelemetry.io/proto/otlp/common/v1"
	metricspb "go.opentelemetry.io/proto/otlp/metrics/v1"
	resource "go.opentelemetry.io/proto/otlp/resource/v1"
	trace "go.opentelemetry.io/proto/otlp/trace/v1"
	"google.golang.org/protobuf/encoding/protojson"
	"google.golang.org/protobuf/proto"
	"math"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
)

func write(dir, name string, b []byte) { must(os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, name), b, 0600)) }
func ids(value any) {
	switch v := value.(type) {
	case map[string]any:
		for k, item := range v {
			if k == "traceId" || k == "spanId" || k == "parentSpanId" {
				raw, e := base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(item.(string))
				must(e)
				v[k] = hex.EncodeToString(raw)
			} else {
				ids(item)
			}
		}
	case []any:
		for _, item := range v {
			ids(item)
		}
	}
}
func emit(dir, name, input string, out proto.Message) {
	must(protojson.Unmarshal([]byte(input), out))
	write(dir, name+"-google-input.json", []byte(input))
	// Fixed context-property replacements preserve EVERY authored number token.
	// An ordinary generic JSON round-trip of input would round its int64 values.
	adapted := strings.ReplaceAll(input, `"traceId":"MDEyMzQ1Njc4OWFiY2RlZg=="`, `"traceId":"30313233343536373839616263646566"`)
	adapted = strings.ReplaceAll(adapted, `"spanId":"YWJjZGVmZ2g="`, `"spanId":"6162636465666768"`)
	write(dir, name+"-input.json", []byte(adapted))
	expected, e := (protojson.MarshalOptions{UseEnumNumbers: true}).Marshal(out)
	must(e)
	write(dir, name+"-google.json", expected)
	var tree any
	must(json.Unmarshal(expected, &tree))
	ids(tree)
	expected, e = json.Marshal(tree)
	must(e)
	write(dir, name+"-canonical.json", expected)
	wire, e := proto.Marshal(out)
	must(e)
	write(dir, name+".protobuf", wire)
}
func main() {
	dir := os.Args[1]
	must(os.MkdirAll(dir, 0700))
	literals := []string{"0", "-0", "0.0", "-0.0", "1", "1.0", "1.000", "1e3", "1E+3", "1e-1", "10e-1", "1.00000000000000000001", "9007199254740993.0", "9.007199254740993e15", "9223372036854775807", "9.223372036854775807e18", "-9223372036854775808", "-9.223372036854775808e18", "9223372036854775808", "18446744073709551615", "18446744073709551616", "184467440737095516150e-1", "4294967295.0", "4294967296.0", "-1.0", "0e1000000", "1e1000000", "1e-1000000", "1e-99999999999999999999999", "1.00000000000000000001e-9999", "0.000000000000000000000001e-9999", "01", "+1", ".0", "1.", " 1", "1 ", "NaN", "Infinity"}
	cases := []map[string]any{}
	for _, kind := range []string{"int64", "uint64", "uint32", "enum"} {
		for _, literal := range literals {
			var out proto.Message
			var field string
			switch kind {
			case "int64":
				out = &common.AnyValue{}
				field = "intValue"
			case "uint64":
				out = &metricspb.HistogramDataPoint{}
				field = "count"
			case "uint32":
				out = &resource.Resource{}
				field = "droppedAttributesCount"
			case "enum":
				out = &trace.Span{}
				field = "kind"
			}
			body := []byte(fmt.Sprintf(`{"%s":%s}`, field, literal))
			err := protojson.Unmarshal(body, out)
			row := map[string]any{"kind": kind, "literal": literal, "accepted": err == nil}
			if err == nil {
				descriptor := out.ProtoReflect().Descriptor().Fields().ByJSONName(field)
				value := out.ProtoReflect().Get(descriptor)
				switch kind {
				case "int64":
					row["expected"] = fmt.Sprint(value.Int())
				case "uint64", "uint32":
					row["expected"] = fmt.Sprint(value.Uint())
				case "enum":
					row["expected"] = fmt.Sprint(value.Enum())
				}
			}
			cases = append(cases, row)
		}
	}
	encoded, e := json.Marshal(cases)
	must(e)
	write(dir, "cases.json", encoded)
	zeros := []map[string]any{}
	for _, literal := range []string{"-0", "-0.0", "-0e0", "-0E+99", "-0e-99", "-0.0e-999", "-1e-1000", "0", "0e0", "1e-0", "1.5e-0"} {
		out := &common.AnyValue{}
		must(protojson.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"doubleValue":`+literal+`}`), out))
		zeros = append(zeros, map[string]any{"literal": literal, "bits": fmt.Sprintf("%016x", math.Float64bits(out.GetDoubleValue()))})
	}
	encoded, e = json.Marshal(zeros)
	must(e)
	write(dir, "floating-zeros.json", encoded)
	emit(dir, "logs", `{"resourceLogs":[{"resource":{"attributes":[{"key":"service.name","value":{"stringValue":"number-fixture"}}],"droppedAttributesCount":1.0},"scopeLogs":[{"scope":{"name":"numbers","droppedAttributesCount":2e0},"logRecords":[{"timeUnixNano":1.700000000123456789e18,"observedTimeUnixNano":1.700000000123457789e18,"severityNumber":9,"flags":2.0,"body":{"intValue":9007199254740993.0},"attributes":[{"key":"minimum","value":{"intValue":-9.223372036854775808e18}},{"key":"zero","value":{"doubleValue":-0}}]}]}]}]}`, &logs.ExportLogsServiceRequest{})
	emit(dir, "metrics", `{"resourceMetrics":[{"resource":{"attributes":[{"key":"service.name","value":{"stringValue":"number-fixture"}}]},"scopeMetrics":[{"scope":{"name":"numbers"},"metrics":[{"name":"exact.scalar","gauge":{"dataPoints":[{"timeUnixNano":1.700000000123456789e18,"asInt":9007199254740993.0,"exemplars":[{"timeUnixNano":1.700000000123456789e18,"asInt":-9.223372036854775808e18}]}]}},{"name":"exact.count","histogram":{"aggregationTemporality":2,"dataPoints":[{"timeUnixNano":1.700000000123456789e18,"startTimeUnixNano":0e1000000,"count":184467440737095516150e-1,"bucketCounts":[1.8446744073709551615e19],"sum":-0,"min":-0}]}},{"name":"exact.summary","summary":{"dataPoints":[{"timeUnixNano":1.700000000123456789e18,"count":2.0,"sum":2,"quantileValues":[{"quantile":0.5,"value":1}]}]}}]}]}]}`, &metrics.ExportMetricsServiceRequest{})
	emit(dir, "traces", `{"resourceSpans":[{"resource":{"attributes":[{"key":"service.name","value":{"stringValue":"number-fixture"}}],"droppedAttributesCount":1.0},"scopeSpans":[{"scope":{"name":"numbers","droppedAttributesCount":2.0},"spans":[{"traceId":"MDEyMzQ1Njc4OWFiY2RlZg==","spanId":"YWJjZGVmZ2g=","name":"numeric","startTimeUnixNano":1.700000000123456789e18,"endTimeUnixNano":1.700000000123457789e18,"flags":257.0,"kind":2,"status":{"code":1},"droppedAttributesCount":1e0,"events":[{"name":"numeric","timeUnixNano":1.700000000123456789e18,"attributes":[{"key":"integer","value":{"intValue":9.007199254740993e15}}]}],"links":[{"traceId":"MDEyMzQ1Njc4OWFiY2RlZg==","spanId":"YWJjZGVmZ2g=","flags":256.0}]}]}]}]}`, &traces.ExportTraceServiceRequest{})
}
func must(e error) {
	if e != nil {
		panic(e)
	}
}
